# Herc & Heimy — Total Battle Research Library

> Unofficial, evidence-labeled research on Total Battle gameplay, combat, XP, and resource economics. Read the evidence policy before using a claim. Player reports are not official confirmations.

## Start
- [AI entry point](AI_START_HERE.md): Retrieval procedure, statuses, and citation format.
- [Evidence policy](docs/evidence-policy.md): How to interpret claims and conflicts.
- [Machine-readable claims](data/claims.json): Stable IDs, status, scope, sources, and article links.
